sources_summary: cumorah.com "Reaching the Nations" Brazil country report (Matt Martinich), 1950-2010: https://cumorah.com/countries/viewReports/191/Brazil
method: 8 real data points spanning 75 years, quoted directly from cumorah.com's decade-by-decade sentence (1950-2010) plus the Church's own current figure (2025). No point between these is interpolated or estimated - years with no findable real figure are simply omitted, following the same rule as membership-by-year.json in this dataset.
